desc: Ideation: model the graph as a functional graph, force equal values on each directed cycle, and choose an O(NM) value-sweep at-most DP with O(N) memory.

Implement the value-sweep O(NM) DP in Python: read stdin; build reverse adjacency and indegrees; Kahn-peel indegree-zero nodes to get non-cycle leaf-to-root order; mark remaining indeg>0 nodes as cycle nodes and extract cycles; maintain cur[u] = #valid assignments in subtree of u with x_u <= current t; for t=1..M update cur[u] += product(cur[v] for v in rev[u]) in order; for each cycle add product over cycle nodes of product(cur[v] for non-cycle children v) to its sum; print product of cycle sums modulo 998244353.
Verify the implementation on the provided samples and edge cases such as N=1 self-loop, pure cycles, star-shaped trees, chains, and multiple components; fix any correctness or performance issues.
